title: Log files fill the disk, how do I configure log rotation?
body: Orbit writes several GB of logs per day. How can I limit log size and keep only a week of history?
author: asker

answers.body:
Set size and retention in `orbit.yaml`:

```yaml
logging:
  maxFileSize: 50MB
  maxHistoryDays: 7
```
